footer: Smriti is a pilot built for the Bolna Voice AI Buildathon. It is not a validated test and never diagnoses. Inspired by the 10/66 Dementia Research Group battery.
demo_banner: Demo mode: no real calls are placed. Calls are simulated with sample conversations and scored by the real engine.
home_title: A 5-minute phone memory check, in Hindi, Kannada or English
home_lead: Smriti calls an older family member and runs a short, friendly memory check by voice. You get a clear summary and a suggested next step.
not_diagnosis: This is a memory check, not a medical test. It never diagnoses. Uncertain results are always looked at by a person.
how_1: You agree to the check and enter a phone number (with their permission).
how_2: Smriti calls and asks a few simple things: repeat numbers, remember words, name animals, today's day and month.
how_3: You get a report: Normal, Uncertain (retest), Refer to a doctor, or Invalid call, with the evidence behind it.
demo_lead: Five sample calls (made-up conversations, no real people), scored by the same engine:
fair_body: No reading or writing needed. Schooling is taken into account. Familiar words, traditional month names accepted. Built on the approach of the 10/66 Dementia Research Group, designed for people with little or no schooling.
consent_label: I have the person's permission. I understand this is a pilot memory check, not a medical test or diagnosis, that the call will be recorded, and that a trained person may review the result.
schooling_hint: Leave empty and Smriti will ask on the call. "0" is a perfectly fine answer.
mode_label: How should Smriti talk to them?
phone_hint: International format, e.g. +919876543210. We keep only the last 4 digits.
consent_required: Please tick the consent box first.
webcall_live: Web call in progress. Speak clearly; the check takes about 5 minutes.
live_lead: This page updates by itself. You can keep it open.
end_declined: The person did not want to do the check today. Nothing was scored.
end_no_answer: No answer. You can try again later.
end_busy: The line was busy. You can try again later.
end_failed: The call could not be completed.
pilot: Pilot - not a validated test - not a diagnosis
timing_experimental: Timing is experimental: the whole naming segment was counted, not exactly 60 seconds.
timing_asr: Counted within 60 seconds using the call recording.
place_note: The town/village answer is accepted if given; a reviewer can check it.
evidence_note: Every score above comes from the words in the call transcript, matched by fixed rules (no AI judgement).
speech_markers: Experimental speech markers (not used for the result)
delete_confirm: Delete the transcript, recording link and scores for this check? This cannot be undone.
deleted: Deleted. Nothing about this check is kept except that it existed.
not_found: Report not found (it may have been deleted).
not_ready: This report is not ready yet.
review_lead: Uncertain, Refer and Invalid results wait here for a trained person.
invalid_caveat: Because the call is invalid, the scores below are shown only for transparency. Do not read them as a result.
load_error: Could not load the report. Please try again in a moment.
